questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Chairperson of the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) in December 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice V. Ramasubramanian.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Former Supreme Court judge Justice V. Ramasubramanian has been appointed as the Chairperson of the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) in December 2024.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Justice V. Ramasubramanian is a retired judge of the Supreme Court of India, having served from September 2019 to June 2023.**
 
• **He has previously held positions as the Chief Justice of the Himachal Pradesh High Court and as a judge in the Madras and Telangana High Courts.**
 
• **His appointment fills the vacancy left by Justice Arun Kumar Mishra, whose tenure as NHRC Chairperson ended on June 1, 2024.**
 
• **Justice Ramasubramanian is known for his contributions to significant judgments, including those related to the 2016 demonetization policy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)**__

 __
 
• Established in 1993, the NHRC is responsible for the protection and promotion of human rights in India.
 
• The Commission consists of a Chairperson, five full-time Members, and several ex-officio Members.
 
• The Chairperson is typically a former Chief Justice of India or a Supreme Court judge.
 
 
 
• **Previous NHRC Chairpersons**__
 __
 
• Justice Arun Kumar Mishra (June 2021 - June 2024)
 
• Justice H.L. Dattu (February 2016 - December 2020)
 
• Justice K.G. Balakrishnan (June 2010 - May 2015)
 
 
 
• **Justice V. Ramasubramanian's Career Highlights**__
 
 
• Born on June 30, 1958, in Tamil Nadu.
 
• Served as a judge in the Madras High Court from 2006 to 2016.
 
• Appointed as the Chief Justice of the Himachal Pradesh High Court in June 2019.
 
• Elevated to the Supreme Court of India in September 2019.

questions.question: Who has been appointed Director of the Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre (LPSC) in January 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**M. Mohan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Noted scientist M. Mohan has been appointed Director of the Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre (LPSC) by the ISRO Chairman.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• M. Mohan was previously the Director (Projects) at the Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC).
 
• He served as the Director of the Human Space Flight Centre from June 2023 to June 2024.
 
• Mohan held significant roles such as Associate Director of VSSC (R&D) and Deputy Director of VSSC (MME and ASOE).
 
• He was the Project Director of the GSLV program and Mission Director for the successful GSLV-F08/GSAT-6A and GSLV-F11/GSAT-7A missions in 2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre (LPSC):**__ A key facility of ISRO responsible for the development of liquid propulsion systems for various space missions.
 
• __**GSLV Program:**__ Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV) missions are crucial for placing heavy payloads into geostationary orbits.
 
• __**M. Mohan’s Contributions:**__ As Project and Mission Director, he played a pivotal role in the successful execution of two GSLV missions in 2018.
 
• __**Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC):**__ A major ISRO facility involved in the design and development of launch vehicles.

questions.question: What is the name of the newly appointed Chief Justice of the Bombay High Court?

 __

• Telangana High Court__

questions.question: Who is the current President of the International Criminal Court (ICC)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Judge Tomoko Akane**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The current President of the International Criminal Court (ICC) is Judge Tomoko Akane.
 
• She was elected to the position on March 11, 2024, for a three-year term. 
 
• Judge Rosario Salvatore Aitala was elected First Vice-President and Judge Reine Alapini-Gansou Second Vice-President.
 
• The Presidency coordinates with the other organs and seeks the concurrence of the Prosecutor on matters of mutual concern.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ICC is the first permanent international criminal court and is governed by a treaty The Rome Statute. 
 
• ICC seeks to hold offenders accountable for their crimes and contribute to their prevention through international criminal justice.
 
• It looks into cases of the most serious crimes of concern to the world community, including genocide, war crimes, crimes against humanity, and crimes of aggression, and brings cases to trial when necessary.
 
• ICC is located in the Hague, Netherlands

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Vice Chief of the Air Staff?

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new CEO-designate of Bharti Airtel? (Oct 2024)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Shashwat Sharma**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Bharti Airtel has made significant leadership changes, appointing Shashwat Sharma as the new MD & CEO effective January 1, 2024, while current MD & CEO Gopal Vittal will transition to the role of Executive Vice Chairman.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Shashwat Sharma, currently the COO, is designated as the CEO **and has started overseeing the entire consumer business, which includes mobility, home, and DTH services.
 
• **Gopal Vittal will remain involved in the business**, focusing on mentoring Sharma and managing enterprise operations and human resources during the transition.
 
• Sharma's full responsibilities as MD & CEO will include both consumer and enterprise businesses when he takes over in 2026.
 
• Under a planned restructuring effective from April 1, 2025, Airtel will decouple its DTH services from its converged entertainment category, creating two separate divisions: Connected Homes (including broadband and entertainment) and DTH. This is aimed at improving competitiveness in both sectors.
 
• Additional appointments include **Siddharth Sharma as Director of Marketing and CEO of Connected Homes**, and** Pushpinder Gujral as CEO and Director of DTH**.
 
• **Shivan Bhargava will lead the newly formed customer experience function.**
